ptr.note: Parent log context (an AVClass-enabled object) of the parser's "Eval" context, read by av_log during the call only; NULL for none. The default callback names the parent too, calling its class's item_name and get_category on it, so it must be an object those callbacks accept: a live object of its class, not merely a struct that starts with the class pointer, unless the class's item_name is NULL or av_default_item_name and it has no get_category (opt::BareObject admits only such classes since the options wave-0 batch-1 review). Wrapped as Option<opt::ObjectRef>.
